title: Sources behind the asset evaluation
scope: External references inform method, rate, currency and diligence context. Project-specific descriptions, grades, effort assumptions and prices remain attributed to the seller records. Market value has not been established.

externalSources.title: Intellectual Property Valuation Basics — The cost method
externalSources.finding: Cost-based reproduction/replacement is a starting point; cost and negotiated value may differ.
externalSources.application: Method selection and the cost-versus-value boundary; no asset amount or discount is supplied by WIPO.
externalSources.useLimit: A method reference; WIPO supplies no asking price, project effort or portfolio discount.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: Software developer freelance rates in 2026
externalSources.finding: Reported 2026 mean software-developer rate: EUR 94/hour excluding VAT; broader survey includes over 20,000 Dutch self-employed people.
externalSources.application: External Dutch rate cross-check. The retained EUR 100–137.50/hour role assumptions reflect an analyst-selected specialist budget and exceed this mean; the mean is not claimed to validate them.
externalSources.access: Primary publisher search result confirms the reported 2026 rate; detailed page access was unavailable during this refresh.
externalSources.useLimit: The EUR 94/hour survey mean is not a minimum, contractor quotation or validation of the higher specialist role assumptions.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: Software developer hiring costs
externalSources.finding: The publisher search result gives a global USD 10-100/hour developer range. The detailed cost page could not be retrieved during this check.
externalSources.application: Broad contractor-rate context only. No asset valuation, Dutch quote or expert-tier premium is inferred.
externalSources.access: Publisher search result; full page unavailable
externalSources.useLimit: Publisher search-result context only. The detailed page was not retrievable. No specialist premium or asset valuation is inferred.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: Euro reference exchange rate - US dollar
externalSources.finding: Retrieved dated observation: 26 October 2026, EUR 1 = USD 1.1188. Indicative display conversion only.
externalSources.application: Indicative USD display conversion only; authoritative project references remain in EUR.
externalSources.useLimit: Display conversion only. The EUR values remain the reference figures; an exchange rate is not valuation evidence.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: International Valuation Standards
externalSources.finding: Valuation approaches, data and inputs, models, documentation and reporting for valuation practice, including intangible assets.
externalSources.application: Method and disclosure context only; this portfolio does not claim IVS compliance or an independent valuation.
externalSources.useLimit: Professional-method context. The public portfolio does not claim IVS compliance or an independent appraisal.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: Valuing in the Absence of Markets
externalSources.finding: Transparency of process and inputs is especially important where market inputs are limited or non-observable.
externalSources.application: Method and disclosure context only; this portfolio does not claim IVS compliance or an independent valuation.
externalSources.useLimit: A private-credit discussion used for transparency principles only; it supplies no software comparable, project price or valuation certification.
externalSources.referenceContext: Financial methodology, rate and currency register

externalSources.title: Uncovering IP Risks and Potential: IP Audit
externalSources.finding: An IP audit considers the assets owned and used, protection gaps, ownership, third-party rights and transfer-related risks.
externalSources.application: Context for distinguishing a seller rights declaration from an evidenced, acquisition-specific rights and component review.
externalSources.useLimit: Reference material for the review framework. It is not a legal opinion, WIPO approval of an asset or evidence that an individual transaction is ready.

externalSources.title: How to Prepare for IP Due Diligence – The Ultimate Guide for Ventures
externalSources.finding: Software acquisition preparation includes a component inventory, ownership evidence, licence obligations, security information and a defined diligence package.
externalSources.application: Context for the five acquisition criteria, outstanding documentation conditions and delivery-specific handover review.
externalSources.useLimit: Reference material for the review framework. It is not a legal opinion, WIPO approval of an asset or evidence that an individual transaction is ready.

externalSources.title: Valuing Intellectual Property Assets
externalSources.finding: Cost, market and income approaches serve different purposes and require asset-specific information.
externalSources.application: Context for the distinction between asking reference, recreation estimate, model sensitivity and an independently supported market value.
externalSources.useLimit: Reference material for the review framework. It is not a legal opinion, WIPO approval of an asset or evidence that an individual transaction is ready.

externalSources.title: Renaming a repository
externalSources.finding: Repository web and Git redirects differ from project-site URL handling. Current project-site routes need their own explicit identity and compatibility mapping.
externalSources.application: Context for current repository URLs and retained project presentation routes. The asset mapping itself is checked against the authenticated repository inventory and stable numeric repository IDs.
externalSources.useLimit: Platform documentation does not assign portfolio IDs, establish first-party ownership or verify an asset price.

externalSources.title: Appliances Energy Prediction — Candanedo (2017)
externalSources.finding: The publisher describes 19,735 building-energy observations at ten-minute intervals; DOI 10.24432/C5VC8G, CC BY 4.0.
externalSources.application: Dataset context for the systems-engine Q1 developer benchmark only. Metrics come from retained project evidence; this page does not validate the implementation or its predictions.
externalSources.useLimit: One building-energy dataset; no independent replication, multi-domain superiority, production acceptance or asset valuation is supplied.
externalSources.referenceContext: Universal-Systems-Intelligence-Engine / Vespera / TA-IP-096 Q1 dataset context

externalSources.title: Bike Sharing — Fanaee-T (2013)

externalSources.application: Dataset context for the systems-engine Q2 E1 exploratory developer comparison; no independent implementation, prediction or financial validation is supplied.
externalSources.useLimit: Review the exact licensed raw-file receipt, missingness and segment selection. No independent replication, domain superiority, production acceptance or asset valuation is supplied.
externalSources.referenceContext: Universal-Systems-Intelligence-Engine / Vespera / TA-IP-096 Q2 dataset context

assessmentRecords.title: Product editions and implemented scope
assessmentRecords.basis: All 110 current asset identities and repository heads reconciled against the preceding source inventory; changed source trees, package editions and retained implementation evidence reviewed in detail.
assessmentRecords.application: Public purpose, functions, outputs, identified version and priced first-party scope.
assessmentRecords.limit: The public summary is not the underlying source code or a guarantee of fitness for a buyer’s deployment.

assessmentRecords.title: Version-specific qualification evidence
assessmentRecords.basis: Retained repository-native test, validation and source-specific qualification records, with explicit distinction between current execution, historical baselines, limited harness checks and pending candidate acceptance.
assessmentRecords.application: Technical and evidence criteria, recorded results and remaining qualification objectives.
assessmentRecords.limit: Results apply to their identified source, environment and tested scope. Publishing these summaries does not rerun or independently certify the products.

assessmentRecords.title: Rights, components and handover records
assessmentRecords.basis: Seller declarations, identified licence/component documentation and retained handover conditions.
assessmentRecords.application: Offered rights, third-party treatment, delivery conditions and recipient acceptance.
assessmentRecords.limit: Documentary indicators do not establish independent legal title, complete licence clearance or a completed transfer.

assessmentRecords.title: Seller cost and commercial inputs
assessmentRecords.basis: All 110 financial records reassessed against current offered/development editions, retained qualification and rights/transfer conditions, explicit scoped budgets and disclosed seller factors. Budget coverage is classified for each asset.
assessmentRecords.application: Eight EUR and USD reference fields, conditional scenarios and portfolio reconciliation.
assessmentRecords.limit: 13 scopes reconcile to full budgets, 36 have partial budgets and 61 retain anchors without a work breakdown. Effort and factors remain seller assumptions, not independent quotes or market value.

assessmentRecords.title: Reproducible arithmetic
assessmentRecords.basis: The public pricing inputs and shared calculation module, with a downloadable deterministic check report.
assessmentRecords.application: 440 scenario outputs, 880 USD conversions, 71 scoped budgets, 49 conditional references and eight totals.
assessmentRecords.limit: A matching calculation checks arithmetic consistency; it does not independently validate the assumptions.

assessmentRecords.title: Proposed workflow applications
assessmentRecords.basis: The documented connection purposes, member roles, workflow requirements and individual asset references.
assessmentRecords.application: The 33 Connections records, with member asking and recreation totals and separately stated integration requirements.
assessmentRecords.limit: These are proposed applications. No working integration, shared rights or additional IP asset is established.

assessmentRecords.title: Asset identity and display linkage
assessmentRecords.basis: Authenticated inventory of 113 repositories matched by stable numeric repository ID to 110 asset identities and three publication/acquisition repositories. Current identity records, feminine reference names and presentation links are reviewed.
assessmentRecords.application: Canonical project title, TA-IP reference and feminine alias across repository identity metadata, asset dossiers, displays, factsheets and product briefs.
assessmentRecords.limit: Identity consistency does not establish ownership clearance, product qualification or market value. Private source and detailed internal records are outside the public register.
